location_and_environment: Campus grounds: great-hall hallways, the courtyard, and the industrial side where cranes and steam rise. Iggy's crane summit revealed a horizon of distant vessels — steam towers, balloons, masts — gathered offshore awaiting the end of testing.

characters_present.name: Iggy
characters_present.status: refused to go to his room; surveyed the campus chaotically; climbed a crane to map everything and grab a cloud; came down under Britt's orders; has a rough map in his notebook

characters_present.name: Ignatius
characters_present.status: following Iggy out of fascination ('curious about Iggy'); held the parts Iggy unbolted; assigned Block 12 with him

characters_present.name: Britt
characters_present.status: did a campus lap with Aggie; ordered Iggy down from the crane; deadpanned at Serra Vox ('take a photo, it'll last longer')

characters_present.name: Lomi
characters_present.status: drawn to the industrial side ('that looks promising'); joined the crane gathering

characters_present.name: Serra Vox
characters_present.status: NPC — prim notebook-carrying woman, not in academy colors; thrilled to find three 'islanders' in one group; just introduced herself to the party

key_items_or_props: a specific cloud Iggy wanted to grab
immediate_preceding_action: Serra Vox introduced herself to the whole party, delighted at finding three clan folk together.
emotional_tone_or_tension: Wandering wonder — first taste of freedom — converging into the party finally gathering as a group, interrupted by an over-curious stranger.
